headline: Nevaeh is raising eyebrows after not denying Blueface claim on stream that she is still MA
body: Nevaeh is raising eyebrows after not denying Blueface claim on stream that she is still MADLY in love with him, even after the two got back together this week. The situation has people talking, especially now that Nevaeh has reportedly made her way back to Blueface’s house for the first time since he broke up with ChriseanRock With their relationship back in the picture, fans are questioning just how deep Nevaeh’s feelings for Blueface really go.
